title: USA joint bid and UK confirmed as 2031 and 2035 Women's World Cup hosts
summary: FIFA on Monday confirmed that a joint bid led by the United States will host the expanded, 48-team Women's World Cup in 2031, while the United Kingdom will host the following edition in 2035.
